title: Formation
paragraphs: “Well, that’s about it.”
Ren sheathed his sword, and Father relaxed his stance. I kept my guard up while resting my spear on my back, and Itsuki approached.
“That was easy.”
“We brute-forced it with our stats, which was a bit of a shame, but we fought according to our plan.”
“Itsuki, you’re amazing. You never hit us even once—just the monsters.”
“At one point, I nearly lost the internal battle about whether or not to hold back, as Motoyasu-san pointed out before…”

It seems that Itsuki confessed as a way to discipline himself. I was keeping a close eye on him, after all. I had already guessed that the current Itsuki could pull this off. And since he acted exactly as expected, it means he wasn’t holding back.
“Hmm… As expected of the heroes. I was watching from afar, and it looked like your movements were perfectly in sync.”
Since Éclair and Yuki-chan’s group would have turned it into a chaotic brawl, we had them step back for training purposes.
“Amazing! Naofumi, you kept capturing monsters the whole time!”
“That’s all I can really do.”
“Ren-sama was taking down monsters together with Motoyasu-sama! It was truly mesmerizing!”
“Honestly, Éclair and you guys are probably still stronger opponents. I need to keep improving…”
“Kawasumi is amazing, too. Even while riding on Kou’s back, he kept landing his shots!”
“I was just shooting arrows from a safe spot, though.”
“The fact that you didn’t hit any allies is what’s amazing.”
“I mean, it probably wouldn’t matter if I hit Naofumi-san, but Ren-san was kind of scary.”
“What!? Why just me!?”
“Ah… yeah, that might be a problem. Ren moves around a lot, so…”
“It’d be great if you could take some notes from Motoyasu-san.”
Ren shot me a look that screamed injustice.
“You kind of rush in without noticing your surroundings sometimes.”
“Even in the future, that was seen as an issue. When focused on a fight, you tend to lose awareness of your surroundings.”
“This probably connects to the fact that you perform well in one-on-one battles.”
“It’s a bit hard to say, but… if I had to be honest for Ren-san’s sake, you’re kind of scary because it feels like you might get hit.”
At Itsuki’s apologetic words, even Ren couldn’t get outright angry—though he did cross his arms with a sour look.
“I tried to move in a way that protected Ren, but even then, if an unexpected attack came his way, it’d be dangerous. Since he charges straight ahead, he could easily get hurt.”
During this fight, Father had been positioning himself to protect Ren. I had been watching carefully.
“Yes, it’s clear when you observe from a distance. You can see how Naofumi-san was protecting Ren-san.”
“Ah, I was debating whether to point it out, but Amaki-dono does have incredible focus. However, in a chaotic battle, that focus seems to work against him.”
“It looked like Ren-sama was fighting while being covered by Naofumi-sama and Motoyasu-sama.”
“Sakura thinks you should be more aware of your surroundings.”
“Otherwise, someone might steal your prey. Kou always watches the battlefield.”
“Ugh…”
Father tried to soothe Ren. Ren was getting utterly torn apart by criticism. It seemed like the right time for someone to step in and mediate. Well, Father naturally took on that role.

“Let’s just keep practicing from here on. Hmm… for now, if you have skills that allow for mid-range or long-range attacks, you should try positioning Yuki-chan as the frontliner and take a step back. That way, you might naturally start seeing more of your surroundings… maybe?”
“That advice sounds uncertain.”
“Yeah, sorry about that. But Ren, you’re like Motoyasu in that you have a wide range of attack options. If you gain more experience, you’ll have even more flexibility than me or Itsuki.”
“Flexibility…”
“I’m specialized in defense, and Itsuki is focused on long-range attacks. That means we have fewer things to learn and our ideal positions in battle are pretty straightforward.”
“So in contrast, Motoyasu and I have a mix of close-and mid-range skills, which means we have more to keep in mind.”
“Exactly. In the end, though, that adaptability will allow you to respond to different situations. The more your skills improve, the better your results will be.”

Ren played with his hair as he pondered. Hmm, Father had been paying close attention. Indeed, my own skills covered both close and long range, though I felt like I had more mid-range abilities, likely due to using a spear. Considering that, Ren leaned more toward close-range skills. If the four heroes could form a solid formation, we’d be an unstoppable force. Father would take the vanguard, Ren would be in the front line, I would handle mid-range, and Itsuki would stay in the rear. That would be an ideal formation. It seemed like Father was pushing for this approach. Of course, I would still step forward when necessary, depending on the situation.
“In the end, you just have to learn through experience.”
“…Hmph.”

Ren, despite his response, started looking through his weapon skills, likely searching for something useful. To others, Ren might seem aware of his surroundings, but in reality, there were times when he was completely oblivious. I had been like that too. Though, in my case, I entrusted support roles to my subordinates while charging ahead on my own. Even then, I was careful not to let any of them get hurt.
“We’ve defeated the number of monsters required for the request. Once we collect the reward, we can head out.”
“I’ll handle the delivery!”

For this request, we needed to bring back materials from the defeated monsters to complete it. The monsters in Éclair’s request were called Brown Goats. Bringing back a certain number of their curled horns would serve as proof of our success. There were still a few more types of monsters we needed to defeat. One of them was the Black Hercules, a large stag beetle. As I was processing the necessary parts from the monsters I had taken down, Ren came over to help…
“Here, Ren… time to dismantle.”
“I-I know! Naofumi, Itsuki, you help too!”
“Well, yeah, but…”
“Ugh, this is a little scary.”
The others hesitated and tried to pass the task off to one another. At first, they were a bit timid, but as they got used to it, they steadily worked through the dismantling.
“Phew… Good thing we’re doing this by the river.”
“If we don’t wash off the blood, it’ll be a hassle later. In that regard, Ren and Motoyasu’s weapons are pretty convenient.”
“Yeah, no bloodstains for us. By the way, anyone can achieve the same effect using a blade with a Blood Clean Coating.”
“A harvesting technique developed for material collection?”
“It’s a magical technique that prevents blood from sticking, so it might have been created for warfare too.”
“Éclair, do you know anything about it?”
“It’s been around for a long time. I don’t know the details.”
“Fooood!”
Sakura and Kou eagerly munched on the meat from the dismantled monsters. Yuki, on the other hand, was more graceful as she tore into her portion.
“Hey! Don’t just eat like wild animals!”
Itsuki complained to Yuki and the others. I wanted to defend the Filolials, but nutritional balance was important, too. Well, I left most of that responsibility to Father anyway.
“Looks like meat dishes would be good for today. With this kind of meat, grilling it quickly might be best.”
“I’m getting tired of grilled meat.”
“Yeah, if we eat the same thing all the time, it gets boring. Try something else.”
“But I have been switching things up! Every meal is different.”
“Still, they’ve all felt kind of similar.”
Ren pointed this out to Father.
“Can’t be helped. I tried to incorporate local specialty dishes, but a lot of them ended up just being variations of the same thing.”
“Then, doesn’t Naofumi have anything new in his repertoire?”
“Honestly, I’m getting tired of trying out local specialties at shops and then tweaking them to suit your tastes.”
“You could just eat at the shops… Why does it always have to be your cooking…?”
At that moment, Éclair lightly cleared her throat.
“You’ve all developed refined palates, haven’t you?”

Ren and Itsuki quickly averted their gazes. It was true—once you got used to Father’s cooking, it was both comforting and strangely addictive. It had a unique flavor that could be called both gourmet and homely.
“…Fine, I’ll whip up something different.”

With that, we finished the dismantling and headed to the guild to report our completion of the request. The reward was split evenly among us. Father and the others held onto their earnings as if they were something truly precious.
